## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and reproducibility commands are updated.
- [ ] Result values retain dataset, split, seed, config, checkpoint, command, and evidence provenance.
- [ ] New visuals have alt text and verified licensing in `docs/assets/README.md`.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private data, restricted dataset, cache, or model weight is included.
- [ ] Scientific claims are evidence-backed or explicitly marked pending.
